deterministic_seam: Reuse and extend M4-5 fake_port.py pattern via a deterministic FakeGitHubAuthorityAdapter (fixture GitHub store) with bounded failure hooks; no production failure injector; deterministic only; never writes production Issue #9.

injection_points.injection: pre-read failure (readRawAuthority throws / transient before any precondition check)
injection_points.expected_behavior: No PREPARED read validation succeeds; request fails before external attempt; journal remains absent or FAILED_NO_EFFECT before attempt; M4-7 not involved; adapter returns typed failure with FAILED_NO_EFFECT or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN depending on whether read proves anything

injection_points.injection: stale precondition (read returns current revision/digest mismatching authorized precondition)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Read-before-write detects stale (revision mismatch or digest mismatch) -> STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed; no external GitHub mutate invoked; no duplicate semantic effect

injection_points.injection: known write failure (mutate returns deterministic known rejection with proven no effect, e.g., STALE detected server-side or permission 403)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Adapter returns adapter_success=False + error_code STALE_AUTHORITY/KNOWN_REJECTION + observed original digest/revision; caller classifies as FAILED_NO_EFFECT; no verify readback needed beyond proving original

injection_points.injection: write timeout (transport timeout/connection reset/response lost; write may have happened but response unavailable)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Adapter returns OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with no proven effect; mandatory verify readback follows; M4-7 handoff is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN -> RECONCILING

injection_points.injection: write success + lost response (transport reports success but caller crashes before persisting terminal)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Stranded APPLYING / J3 window; future run re-reads authoritative raw store and classifies via three-way candidate/original/third; J10 mapped if terminal persist failed after candidate proven

injection_points.injection: verify read failure (verify readback throws / unavailable after apparent mutate)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Surface OUTCOME_UNKNOWN for that object; partial-effect classification; M4-7 RECONCILING retries read idempotently before any retry authorization check
Three-way classifier -> CANDIDATE_OBSERVED -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED (or direct VERIFIED if first-attempt success path); no retry needed; Event Log append may still reconcile
ORIGINAL_OBSERVED -> RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only with fresh authorization + fresh Subject + fresh raw precondition + new bounded lease; otherwise stays RETRYABLE until those fresh bindings arrive

injection_points.injection: third-state readback (verify returns observed third-state raw digest != original != candidate; includes normalized equality but raw mismatch)
injection_points.expected_behavior: CONFLICT_THIRD -> CONFLICT terminal (needs semantic choice); no heuristic overwrite; normalized equality supporting-only does not flip to VERIFIED

injection_points.injection: projection partial failure (Issue body candidate observed but one projection comment stale/permission fail, or Event Log append fails)
injection_points.expected_behavior: Partial-effect classified per multi-object model; authority effect handed to M4-7 as candidate observed; projection failure as per-object outcome; Event Log append retry only via fresh journal observation; no cross-object atomic claim

fixture_expectations.fixture_github_store: In-memory Issue body store (body string + opaque revision token + digest + comment map keyed by role with per-comment revision/digest) isolated per test; deterministic revision bump on successful write; no network; no gh CLI
fixture_expectations.production_github_write_in_tests: not allowed; tests use fixture; PRODUCTION_GITHUB_ACCEPTANCE_WRITE_ALLOWED=no; no test may mutate Issue #9
fixture_expectations.coverage: All 10 injection points above map to acceptance matrix POS/NEG cases and J1-J10 crash windows (J1 pre-prepared, J2 known failure, J3 stranded applying, J4 unknown, J5 retryable, J6 candidate, J7 third, J8 normalized, J9 durability fail, J10 nonterminal after terminal)
